jeans.description: ShopMart offers a wide range of jeans for men and women in various fits and washes.
jeans.careTips: Machine wash cold with similar colors. Avoid bleach. Tumble dry low or hang dry to maintain shape.
jeans.buying Tips: Check waist and length measurements before ordering. Stretch denim recommended for a comfortable everyday fit.

bags.description: ShopMart stocks a variety of bags including handbags, backpacks, tote bags, laptop bags, and travel bags.
bags.careTips: Wipe leather bags with a damp cloth. Store in dust bags when not in use. Avoid overloading to preserve shape.
bags.buying Tips: For laptop bags, check compartment size compatibility with your laptop size (13", 15", or 17"). For daily use, a tote or crossbody is ideal.

glasses.description: ShopMart offers sunglasses, reading glasses, and fashion eyewear for men, women, and kids.
glasses.careTips: Clean with a microfiber cloth only. Store in a hard case when not in use. Avoid placing lenses face-down.
glasses.buying Tips: Look for UV400 or UV protection labels for sunglasses. Polarized lenses reduce glare and are great for driving or outdoor use.

tshirts.description: ShopMart has a large collection of casual, graphic, polo, and plain t-shirts for men, women, and kids.
tshirts.careTips: Machine wash cold. Dry in shade to prevent fading. Iron inside-out for printed tees.
tshirts.buying Tips: 100% cotton is breathable and ideal for summer. Dry-fit fabric is best for workouts. Check size chart as cuts vary by brand.

shoes.description: ShopMart offers footwear for all occasions including sneakers, formal shoes, sandals, heels, and sports shoes.
shoes.careTips: Clean leather shoes with a damp cloth and condition regularly. Use shoe trees to maintain shape. Air out sports shoes after use.
shoes.buying Tips: Measure both feet and order based on the larger foot. Shoe sizes can vary between brands — always check the size guide. For sports shoes, choose based on activity type (running, gym, outdoor).

jackets.description: ShopMart stocks jackets for all seasons including windbreakers, hooded jackets, leather jackets, denim jackets, and winter puffer jackets.
jackets.careTips: Leather jackets should be wiped clean and stored in breathable covers. Puffer jackets can be machine washed on gentle cycle. Hang jackets rather than folding to keep shape.
jackets.buying Tips: For winter warmth, opt for puffer or fleece-lined jackets. Leather and denim jackets are great for styling. Check fill weight for puffers — higher fill means warmer jacket.

suits.description: ShopMart offers formal suits, shalwar kameez suits, women's lawn suits, and wedding/occasion wear for men and women.
suits.careTips: Dry clean formal suits. Hand wash or gentle machine wash lawn suits. Steam iron embroidered areas carefully. Store in suit bags.
suits.buying Tips: For formal suits, measure chest, waist, and trouser inseam. Unstitched suits offer more customization through a local tailor. Look for lawn brands for spring/summer season.

faq.question: What are the best deals on ShopMart right now?
faq.answer: Right now, ShopMart is running a Summer Mega Sale with up to 50% off. Every Friday there is a 30% Fashion Flash Deal with code FRIDAY30. New users get 15% off their first order with code WELCOME15.

faq.question: How do I track my order?
faq.answer: Go to My Orders in your account dashboard. Click on your order to see the real-time delivery status and tracking number once shipped.

faq.question: Can I cancel my order?
faq.answer: Yes, you can cancel before the order is shipped. Go to My Orders, select your order, and click Cancel. Once shipped, cancellation is not possible but you can return it after delivery.

faq.question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
faq.answer: Report it within 48 hours through My Orders → Report Issue. ShopMart will arrange a free replacement or full refund.

faq.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
faq.answer: Yes, COD is available on orders up to Rs. 50,000 in most cities across Pakistan. Availability is confirmed at checkout based on your address.

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days and is free on orders above Rs. 1,500. Express delivery takes 1–2 business days for an extra Rs. 300.

faq.question: What is the return policy?
faq.answer: You can return unused items in original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Initiate the return from My Orders. Refund is processed in 3–5 business days.

faq.question: How do I become a seller on ShopMart?
faq.answer: Click 'Become a Seller' on ShopMart, fill in your business details, upload your CNIC, and verify your mobile number. Payouts are every 14 days.

faq.question: What payment methods does ShopMart accept?
faq.answer: ShopMart accepts Cash on Delivery, Visa/Mastercard, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Bank Transfer. All online payments are SSL secured.

faq.answer: Top-selling categories include are Jeans, Bags, Shoes, and Jackets ; Lawn Suits and Sneakers in Fashion.
